name: Bribe Taker
oracle_text:
Trample
When this creature enters, for each kind of counter on permanents you control, you may put your choice of a +1/+1 counter or a counter of that kind on this creature.
blocked_sentences: When this creature enters, for each kind of counter on permanents you control, you may put your choice of a +1/+1 counter or a counter of that kind on this creature.

needs.what: an iteration over the distinct counter kinds present on a set of permanents (here: permanents you control), binding each kind so the loop body can name it as a counter type; the body is an optional choice between add_counters +1/+1 and add_counters of the bound kind on the source
needs.why_existing_wont_do: for_each iterates objects, not counter kinds; add_counters takes a printed `counter` string with no way to read a bound kind; move_counters/remove_counters have any_kind/all_kinds but those act on counters already on an object rather than enumerating kinds to put new ones; value_keys has `distinct` and `counters_on` but neither yields the set of kinds as a loop domain or a counter-name binding
